<br>
The '''AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 14: Wild Card Qualifier''' was the tournament held on July 17, 2022 to determine the seed for the [[AfreecaTV_StarCraft_League_Remastered/14|AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 14]]. Because [[Rain]] decided not to participate, due to a wrist injury.
